name: Stephen Howe
location: Norwich, UK | Remote | Permanent or contract

creative-technologist.title: Creative Technologist
creative-technologist.summary: Creative technologist and hands-on creative lead with 20+ years across design, media and technology. Lead Designer at UNCX Network since December 2021, spanning brand, product interfaces, 3D and motion. I develop concepts into finished work: generative image/video and audio production in ComfyUI, complete brand films, reusable production systems and React-based prototypes. My practice connects art direction and storytelling with the technical judgement needed to make the work hold together.

design-engineer.title: Design Engineer
design-engineer.summary: Designer and hands-on builder combining product and interaction design with React, TypeScript and full-stack personal projects. Lead Designer at UNCX Network since December 2021, with 20+ years across design and technology. I turn complex requirements into user flows, reusable components and working interfaces, using AI-assisted development, scoped implementation and verification. Background in 3D and motion brings an additional focus on visual craft and interaction detail.

product-designer.title: Product Designer
product-designer.summary: Product designer with deep technical and creative-production fluency. Lead Designer at UNCX Network since December 2021, designing product flows, interfaces, design systems and educational experiences. I combine user experience and visual design with hands-on React prototyping and first-hand generative video and audio production. Comfortable moving from ambiguous requirements to implementation detail, collaborating with engineers and creative partners.

experience.title: Lead Designer
bullets: Sole in-house designer across brand, product interfaces, 3D, motion and marketing, working with developers, marketing and external creative partners.
Designed wireframes and UI concepts for 10+ applications, with 3-4 shipped to production; mapped unfamiliar token-tool and Telegram workflows in FigJam and Figma.
Led the 2022 rebrand from Unicrypt Network to UNCX Network, then directed an outside studio on the 2024 rebrand and completed the website, Academy and 10+ pages in-house.
Produced 200+ tutorials, explainers and launch videos, including 30+ for UNCX Academy, and built the 3D and motion template system behind them.
Created four AI-generated launch films for partner Quiver, rendered locally with Wan 2.2.
Designed and built Solana Diary for a UNCX partner: a 7-service pipeline turning live Solana data into on-brand X graphics, with Telegram asset approval gates.
Designed a variable-driven Figma design system for cross-product navigation, now live across the product suite.

experience.title: Designer
bullets: Delivered design and production assets for 30 shipped games, working within the Art Lead's direction as an embedded member of the development team.
Created graphics, animation, 3D and launch marketing packs; prepared and compressed assets, built sprite sheets and committed work directly through Git and SVN.
Supported game localisation, accessibility adaptations and asset QA across concurrent releases.

experience.title: Designer and Animator
experience.context: International clients | Video, animation and web
bullets: Delivered video, motion graphics and web projects, including 140+ videos for one corporate-learning client by January 2018.
Filmed, edited and delivered a digital chef-training course and website for Chalet Chardons; recipes and operational content by head chef Maciek Dolasinski.
Produced music videos and explainers with rotoscoping and colour grading; improved website UI, content and SEO for international leisure clients.

motion.title: UNCX Video & 3D System
motion.body: Built a modular creative-production workflow in Cinema 4D, Redshift and After Effects. Reusable scenes, materials and timeline structures support UNCX launches, tutorials and education without rebuilding every asset from scratch.

solana.title: Solana Diary
solana.body: Designed the brand and templates, and built seven Railway services connecting live-data APIs, code-driven rendering, rate limiting, Telegram approval and X publishing. Every post required human approval. Built with AI tools; Grok was an optional, button-triggered assist.

badger.title: Badger Club
badger.body: Designed and built a badge-tracking product with React, Supabase, Google authentication and Resend. Scoped the product to leader-only accounts with parent communication without sign-up. Owned UI, database structure and implementation using AI-assisted development.

academy.title: UNCX Academy
academy.body: Connected learning-platform design with creative production: article, video and glossary experiences plus educational media. Wrote the brief, completed page designs and graphics, and collaborated with external designers and the in-house developer.

menu.title: UNCX Unified Menu
menu.body: Researched navigation patterns and designed a shared product hierarchy with variable-driven Figma components, documented states and configurable content. Balanced product priority with discoverability. Signed off and implemented across the product suite.

noticia.title: Noticia Lingo
noticia.body: Designed and built a language-learning app from news articles with React, Supabase and Google authentication. Every lesson type is built, with learning levels, a multilingual framework and legal groundwork for a US and EU launch.

quiver.title: Quiver: Generative Launch Films
quiver.body: Created four launch films for Quiver, a UNCX partner, from a sparse brief. Designed constrained source plates around model limits, rendered three to five attempts per scene locally with Wan 2.2 in ComfyUI, and built modular After Effects scenes with AI-assisted production scripts.
